title: GTFS Scorecard grade audit trail
description: The output of `scorecard explain ARTIFACT --format json` (#364): how one published grade was reached, rebuilt from the artifact and the scoring constants of its rubric_version. It is a report, not a published API document: it is written on demand, and an artifact scored under a rubric this build has no constants for is refused with exit code 2 and produces no document at all. The document has no schema_version field. This schema describes the shape as of rubric 1.3, and a change to that shape changes this file in the same commit. A category that was not measured carries null for every figure, never zero, and its weight is redistributed across the measured categories.

agency.description: The registry id of the feed record.

measured_total.description: The sum of the rubric weights of the categories that were measured. Below 1 exactly when a category was not measured.

renormalised.description: True when a category was not measured and its weight was redistributed across the measured ones. The key keeps its original spelling because this output is public.

recomputed.description: The weighted sum of the exact contributions, unrounded beyond four decimals.

recomputed_published.description: The recomputed sum at the published rounding.

published.description: The overall score the artifact publishes.

reconciles.description: Whether the recomputed score equals the published one at the published rounding. False is reported, never hidden: see reconciliation_note.

margin_to_next_band.description: Points to the next grade band up, or null at the top band.

margin_to_lower_band.description: Points above the floor of the current grade band.

rubric_weight.description: The category's weight in the rubric before any redistribution.

applied_weight.description: The weight actually applied: the rubric weight divided by the measured total. Null when the category was not measured.

contribution.description: score times applied_weight, this category's exact share of the overall score.

points_total.description: The sum of the listed deductions, or null when the category was not measured.

score_delta.description: The category's distance from 100, or null when the category was not measured.

residual.description: What the listed deductions do not account for. Reported with its reason, never absorbed.

residual_reason.description: Why a residual is not an error, or "unexplained" when it is one. Empty when there is no residual.
